scope: Make authenticated PRE-CU combat select its Core3 hit/secondary-defense route before the inherited NGE result tables and preserve authored three-pool HAM costs without allowing NGE free-shot expertise to replace them.

findings: Publish 14.1 attack admission, primary accuracy, secondary defense, and HAM costs are skill-, weapon-, posture-, and command-authored rather than expertise-driven.
All retained profession and NPC combat actions are already authenticated by precu_combat_overrides.tab, and every row supplies an explicit target pool and PRE-CU HAM-cost model.

The previous dispatcher could select the inherited NGE hit tables through a fallback sentinel even after entering PRE-CU resolution; current complete family profiles made that unlikely, but the control-flow boundary was not fail-closed.

Single-target PRE-CU actions reached the inherited success-based free-shot helper after their authored HAM cost was calculated, allowing five NGE freeshot skill modifiers to replace the cost with zero.
Area costs remain drained once before the hit engine; their per-defender success-cost result must remain zero to prevent duplicate drains.

auditBoundary.closedInThisMilestone: authenticated PRE-CU hit-result dispatch and single-target success-cost handling can no longer cross into inherited NGE expertise authority
auditBoundary.preserved: Core3 primary and secondary defense, authored three-pool costs, one-time area cost draining, PRE-CU block/dodge/counter/ricochet, NGE compatibility helpers for retained later content, and all expansion quests/zones
auditBoundary.notClaimedComplete: non-combat and content-specific expertise references, plus inherited combat helpers reachable only from non-authenticated later-content actions, remain subject to later reachability audits

requiredBeforeReady: healthy live cluster using the built binary
